decision: Data integrations (GitHub, Jira, Confluence) must be built before the Decision Ledger so decisions link to real operational signals from day one.
key_insight: Data integrations (GitHub, Jira, Confluence) must be built before the Decision Ledger so decisions link to real operational signals from day one.
alternatives_considered: Build Decision Ledger first as the core differentiator
Build Work Radar first using manual entry
rejected_reason: Decision Ledger entries are meaningless without real work items to link to
Manual entry creates friction that kills adoption before value is demonstrated
